description: An X25519 private key whose d (RFC 7748 §6.1 Alice's private key 77076d0a…1db92c2a) does not derive its x (RFC 7748 §6.1 Bob's public key de9edb7d…6f882b4f, itself a valid key) is rejected at import (ADR 0043 §3, amending ADR 0041 §4; RFC 8037 §2, RFC 7748 §6.1: the public key is X25519(d, 9)). Derived independently of polyjose with the RFC 7748 §5 Montgomery ladder in pure Python: Alice's d derives hSDwCYkw…qqbTmo, not this x
